title: What Does Focus Do in GTA 6? It's the New Dead Eye 🎯 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 has its own Dead Eye: Focus. Click both sticks (L3 + R3) to slow time. Enemies get marked: red spots are lethal, yellow spots are non-lethal. It also highlights a car's engine, fuel tank and tires. The purple Focus bar only drains in combat. Coffee, tea, sleeping or showering at your safehouse refills it faster, and your Criminal Profile decides which combat actions refill it (headshots for Violent/Psycho, non-lethal takedowns for Professional/Hardened). Shooting ranges, golf putting, pool and fishing permanently extend the bar.

Source: GTABase, "GTA 6 Focus Ability Explained: How It Works & What It Does".
